## e99db35d533d

Generator SHA: `f7135a973cff3fa1c4622ccc0d00115fdbf22b0f6044fecbc8863a5abd596994`.
Raw rule SHA: `3e0786e96c918442b96370710f215fe484f7d25ebe8888ca01a5f161aebe743f`.
No target `self_check` hook exists; validator status is unavailable, not pass.
Actual Racket matches all three canonical pairs.

**A2: Reproduced placement/count contract defect and ignored axes.**
Default seed67,index0,easy records n_top=2,n_interior=2 but produces one top and
two interior components. Explicitly forcing n_top=2,n_interior=2 reproduces it.
This exact generated input is in the documented 8-halo-separated domain and is
saved at `checks/counterexamples/audit_e99db35d533d_forced_counts.json`, including
actual Racket output. The eight-connected rival equals Racket for this case;
this is a count failure, not a contradictory output label.

Across seeds0..99,index0,easy/medium/hard: **9/300** default draws do not realize
the recorded top/interior counts; 300/300 inputs are unique. All mismatches are
retained. Placement failures are ignored after bounded attempts, and the final
fallback promises only one object of each category rather than requested counts.

For each of 20 seeds0..19,index0,medium, changing blob_size from2 to6 gives exactly
the same input (20/20); changing palette_kind warm to cool also does (20/20).
Source inspection confirms neither controls placement. Source color1 is part of
the rule, so removing the misleading palette axis is preferable to changing the
semantic source color. These axis probes are 40 paired comparisons, not40
Racket-validated label examples.

**A3: Verified connectivity coverage gap; the distinguishing case is outside the
restricted generator domain.** The sampler enforces full 8-neighbor halos. The
rival recolors the entire eight-connected blue component linked to the top edge.
It fits all3 canonical pairs and all300 generated audit inputs, so this sample
provides no evidence teaching 4-versus-8 connectivity.

Construct an8x9 zero grid with blue1 at (0,0),(1,0),(2,1),(2,2). Racket recolors
only (0,0),(1,0) to4; the rival recolors all four cells. Exact outputs are in
`checks/counterexamples/audit_e99db35d533d_diagonal.json` and were directly
Racket-checked. This obeys the written 4-connected top-touching task rule but
violates the generator's explicit 8-halo separation. It is therefore a
**domain/coverage question**, not an in-domain generator parity failure.

Suggested repair, not applied: make counts observable and exact or reject
infeasible calls; remove/honor dead axes; explicitly decide whether diagonal
contact is part of the intended curriculum, and schedule it if so. A blanket
halo relaxation without checking cardinal merges would reintroduce a different
label/contrast failure.
